units.source_text: 下决心烧金阁以后，我仿佛再次处在少年时代初起对那种崭新的无垢的状态，

en.t: After resolving to burn the Golden Pavilion, I felt as though I had once again entered that fresh and innocent state from the beginning of my boyhood,

units.source_text: 所以我想也应该再次邂逅人生开始时遇见的人和事。

en.t: and so I thought that I should once again encounter the people and things I had met at the beginning of my life.
